fact: Wearetech reports that the SDAN, the framework for digital infrastructure and services, was adopted in 2019; the document gives no period for it and names no successor.

Wearetech reports that ministry and territorial-development representatives met 6-12 September 2026 to consolidate the draft revised SDAN to 2030, to go next to the national commission for territorial planning (CNADDT).
Sidwaya reports the minister saying at the 24 October 2025 launch of the OAN platform that the SDAN was adopted in 2019; no period or successor is given.
